accepted_answers.name: BeautifulSoup (bs4, preferably with the lxml backend)
accepted_answers.why: Forgiving real parser with a beginner-friendly API; handles the malformed markup regex cannot.

accepted_answers.name: lxml.html
accepted_answers.why: Accepted fast C-backed alternative with XPath support for high-volume or precise DOM work.

notes: Very strong consensus, decades old: HTML is not a regular language; regex cannot handle nesting/broken markup. Regex is only acceptable for cleanup of already-extracted plain text.
problem: Extracting data from HTML in Python using regular expressions instead of a parser.
